_comment_weights_file: Corrected from the original template's 'model.safetensor' (not shipped) to the actual fine-tuned checkpoint file that was provided.
_comment_checkpoint_state_dict_key: mamba_head_epoch_3.pth is a full PyTorch TRAINING checkpoint (epoch/model_state_dict/optimizer_state_dict/loss), not a bare safetensors state_dict. The adapter unwraps this key before calling load_state_dict().
_comment_hard_constraint: No hard_constraint file was shipped with this fine-tune. HardConstraint (sen2sr.models.tricks.HardConstraint) is a fixed, non-learned Fourier low-pass mask that depends only on (output_size, scale_factor) -- not on backbone weights. This file is byte-identical to sen2sr_cnn's hard_constraint.safetensor, which is a valid substitute because both configs share patch_size=128 and scaling_factor=4 (output size 512x512, verified against the shipped tensor shape). Replace this file if a fine-tune-specific hard_constraint.safetensor is ever produced.
description: SEN2SR RGBN x4 (Mamba backbone), fine-tuned checkpoint at epoch 3. Base architecture from tacofoundation/SEN2SR 'mamba-rgbn-x4', repackaged in the WEO-SAS/sen2sr HuggingFace layout.
